list_openai_models: list all available OpenAI pretrained CLIP model names using list_openai_models
load_openai_model_by_name: load an OpenAI CLIP model by name using load_openai_model with a model name string
load_openai_model_from_path: load a CLIP model from a local checkpoint file path using load_openai_model
load_openai_model_non_jit: load a non-JIT CLIP model by passing jit=False to load_openai_model for a hackable model
load_openai_model_to_cpu: load an OpenAI CLIP model onto the CPU device using load_openai_model with device set to cpu
